plugins.name: found
plugins.description: Work with your Found business banking and bookkeeping in Claude: check balances, export transactions, close the month, reconcile accounts, review profit and loss, and chase unpaid invoices. Read-only.

skills.name: accountant-packet
skills.description: Put together a quarter-end or year-end package from the user's Found books for their accountant or bookkeeper, including profit and loss, a categorized ledger, open items, and balances. Use when the user is preparing for tax season, year-end, a quarterly review, a meeting with their accountant or CPA, a loan application, or asks for "everything my accountant needs".
skills.description_zh: 根据 Found 账簿整理季末或年末会计资料包，包括损益、分类明细账、未结事项和余额，用于税季、季度复盘、会计师会面或贷款申请。

skills.name: cash-snapshot
skills.description: Summarize balances across the user's Found businesses and accounts. Use when the user asks how much money they have, what their balance is, how much is in a specific pocket or account, what is pending, or wants a quick cash overview.
skills.description_zh: 汇总用户各 Found 企业和账户余额，说明指定子账户金额与待处理项目，形成快速现金概览。

skills.name: export-transactions
skills.description: Export the user's Found transactions for a date range to a spreadsheet or CSV. Use when the user asks to export, download, pull, or dump transactions, get a transaction history, or build a ledger for a month, quarter, or year.
skills.description_zh: 按日期范围将 Found 交易导出为工作簿或 CSV，用于月、季、年交易历史和明细账。

skills.name: find-transactions
skills.description: Find specific transactions or answer spending questions in the user's Found account. Use when the user asks about a particular charge, payment, deposit, or vendor ("what was that $400 charge", "did the client pay me", "how much did we spend at Amazon", "what did I pay for software last quarter").
skills.description_zh: 查找 Found 中具体收费、付款、存款或供应商交易，回答客户是否付款、某供应商开支或期间软件支出等问题。

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: Show what the assistant can do with the user's Found account and suggest useful next steps based on their data. Use when the user has just connected Found, asks what Found can do here, asks how to use Found in this chat, or asks for ideas about managing their business finances with Found.
skills.description_zh: 介绍助手可对已连接 Found 账户执行的工作，并依据数据提出业务财务管理的下一步。

skills.name: month-end-close
skills.description: Review a month of the user's Found bookkeeping and produce a checklist of what to fix before the books are closed. Use when the user wants to close the month, clean up their books, catch up on bookkeeping, find uncategorized transactions or missing receipts, or get ready for their accountant.
skills.name_hint: 月份 · end · 结账/关闭
skills.description_zh: 复核 Found 单月记账，生成关账前修正清单，检查未分类交易、缺失收据和待整理项目，以便月结或交给会计师。

skills.name: profit-loss-and-taxes
skills.description: Summarize the user's profit and loss from their Found books and help them think about how much to set aside for taxes. Use when the user asks about profit, income, expenses, margins, top spending categories, how the business is doing, month-over-month or year-over-year trends, or how much to save for taxes or quarterly estimated taxes.
headings: Profit and loss, and tax set-aside
skills.description_zh: 汇总 Found 损益、收入、费用、利润率、主要支出类别及环比同比趋势，并帮助估算税款或季度预缴的预留金额。

skills.name: reconcile
skills.description: Reconcile the user's Found accounts for a period by checking the books against the bank activity, rolling balances forward, and matching Stripe payouts to deposits. Use when the user asks to reconcile, balance the books, check that numbers match, figure out why a balance looks wrong, or match payouts or deposits.
headings: Check 3: Stripe payouts (when the business uses Stripe)
skills.description_zh: 将 Found 账簿与银行流水按期间对账、滚动核对余额，并匹配 Stripe 结算与入账，排查余额差异和未匹配款项。

skills.name: unpaid-invoices
skills.description: Review the user's unpaid and overdue Found invoices, age them, and draft follow-up messages to clients. Use when the user asks who owes them money, which invoices are unpaid or overdue, about accounts receivable, whether a client has paid, or wants help chasing late payments.
skills.description_zh: 复核 Found 未付及逾期发票、计算账龄并起草客户跟进消息，用于应收账款查询和迟付催收。

name: found
